classes/watch-detective-623.name: City Watch Training
classes/watch-detective-623.description: At 1st level gain a +2 insight bonus on Listen, Search, Sense Motive, and Spot checks.

classes/watch-detective-623.name: Expertise
classes/watch-detective-623.description: At 2nd level gain the Expertise feat regardless of Intelligence score.

classes/watch-detective-623.name: Obsessive Specialty
classes/watch-detective-623.description: At 2nd level choose one Knowledge skill. Gain a bonus equal to Watch Detective class level on checks with that Knowledge skill.

classes/watch-detective-623.name: Profile
classes/watch-detective-623.description: At 2nd level, with a successful Gather Information check against DC 15 while speaking with a witness, form a roughly accurate image of an accused perpetrator. The resulting verbal or visual depiction grants +2 insight on further Gather Information checks with witnesses to that crime or people acquainted with the perpetrator.

classes/watch-detective-623.name: Cooperative Interrogation
classes/watch-detective-623.description: At 3rd level, when assisting another watch detective questioning the same subject, grant a +4 circumstance bonus on that ally's Bluff, Diplomacy, Intimidate, or Sense Motive check.

classes/watch-detective-623.name: Superior Disarming
classes/watch-detective-623.description: At 3rd level gain a +4 bonus on attack rolls made to disarm an opponent.

classes/watch-detective-623.name: Deductive Augury
classes/watch-detective-623.description: Beginning at 4th level, as a standard action make an assertion about a mystery, puzzle, or trap. The chance to receive a correct true-or-untrue answer is 70% + 1% per Watch Detective class level. Use this once per day at 4th level, twice per day at 7th, and three times per day at 10th.

classes/watch-detective-623.name: Skill Synergy
classes/watch-detective-623.description: At 4th level choose one source-listed skill pair. If you have at least 5 ranks in both selected skills, gain a +2 synergy bonus on checks involving both.

classes/watch-detective-623.name: No Subdual Penalty
classes/watch-detective-623.description: At 5th level you can deal subdual damage with a weapon that normally deals regular damage without taking the usual -4 attack penalty.

classes/watch-detective-623.name: Sense Secret Doors
classes/watch-detective-623.description: At 5th level, merely passing within 5 feet of a secret or concealed door entitles you to a Search check as if actively looking. An elven Watch Detective gains +2 insight on such Search checks.

classes/watch-detective-623.name: Locate Object
classes/watch-detective-623.description: At 6th level produce an effect identical to locate object as a sorcerer of your Watch Detective class level.

classes/watch-detective-623.name: Improved Subdual
classes/watch-detective-623.description: At 7th level add Intelligence bonus, if positive, to subdual damage dealt with any weapon.

classes/watch-detective-623.name: Forensics
classes/watch-detective-623.description: At 8th level, a successful Search check against DC 20 while examining a corpse reveals the cause of death, approximate size and strength of an attacker, and other key evidence. You may take 20 given enough time.

classes/watch-detective-623.name: Discern Lies
classes/watch-detective-623.description: At 9th level use discern lies as a spell-like ability once per day at a caster level equal to Watch Detective class level.

classes/watch-detective-623.name: Locate Creature
classes/watch-detective-623.description: At 9th level use locate creature as a spell-like ability once per day at a caster level equal to Watch Detective class level.

classes/watch-detective-623.name: Instant Knowledge
classes/watch-detective-623.description: At 10th level, once per day make an Intelligence check against DC 20 with a +10 insight bonus to answer one question within a particular Knowledge skill, even if untrained in that skill.
